name: Lean Bite
description: Bite into the foe's soul force with a lean hungry strike that draws a thin stream.

name: Starve Mark
description: Mark the foe's soul with a hunger that tells the user where its force runs thinnest.

name: Drain Knot
description: Tie a knot in the foe's flow of soul force so that his technique stalls.

name: Devouring Screen
description: Raise a screen that gorges on the force of any soul strike that meets it.

name: Wane Stride
description: Stride from the foe's reach as the draw on his soul makes him wane for a breath.

name: Hunger Chain
description: Wrap the foe's soul in a chain of hunger that feeds on every struggle against it.

name: Soul Mouthful
description: Drive a mouth of soul force through the foe's guard and tear out a full mouthful of his reserve.

name: Slow Leech
description: Set a slow leech on the foe's soul that dims his focus a little each breath.

name: Ravening Palm
description: Strike with a palm that ravens at the soul beneath the skin and takes a share of it.

name: Sapping Ward
description: Hold a ward that saps the force from every soul attack that presses on it.

name: Famine Sense
description: Feel the famine in a soul to judge how long the foe can hold out.

name: Greedy Step
description: Take a greedy step toward the nearest fat soul while the foe's attention is held.

name: Force Lap
description: Lap up the force just drawn and let it settle in the user's own soul.

name: Feeding Bind
description: Hold the foe's soul fast while a steady stream of its force flows into the user.

name: Hunger Dart
description: Throw a dart of hunger that sticks in the foe's soul and keeps drinking.

name: Taint Eater
description: Eat a clinging taint or erosion out of an ally's soul and leave it clean.

name: Swallow Blow
description: Strike a blow that swallows a measure of the foe's force as it lands.

name: Gullet Guard
description: Open a gullet before the soul that swallows a soul strike whole.

name: Bite Sense
description: Take a tiny bite of a soul to learn its flavor and rung.

name: Gnaw Pace
description: Gnaw through the foe's guard in a quick pace and leave before he can answer.

name: Ingest Barrage
description: Loose a barrage of small mouths that each swallow a morsel of the foe's force.

name: Bottomless Ward
description: Hold a ward with no floor that swallows whatever soul force is thrown at it.

name: Open Jaws
description: Throw open the jaws of the soul and close them on the foe's reserve.

name: Jaw Sense
description: Set the jaws wide to catch the scent of any soul within a short range.

name: Empty Throat
description: Hollow the foe's throat of soul so that he cannot give voice to a technique.

name: Devouring Shield
description: Raise a shield that grows heavier with every soul strike it eats.

name: Tooth Step
description: Step on the edge of the foe's attention like a tooth on a bone and slip away.

name: Sunken Draught
description: Drink a deep draught of the drawn force and steady the whole soul with it.

name: Grinding Bite
description: Grind through a guard with a bite that cannot be turned.

name: Bottomless Maw
description: Open a maw that has no bottom to swallow any soul attack whole.

name: Maw Chain
description: Throw a chain of maws about the foe's soul that holds it as they feed.

name: Last Swallow
description: Swallow what remains of a broken foe's soul force in a single closing blow.
